description: Keep your server meta balanced. chroma's enchant banner is a lightweight, ultra-efficient 1.21.x Paper plugin that lets you restrict specific enchantments on precise item types with absolute bypasses for admins.
body:
# 🛡️ About chroma's enchant banner
Tired of players putting Mending on easily replaceable custom armor sets? Or maybe Sharpness on axes ruins your PvP server's delicate balance? Say hello to **chroma's enchant banner** - the definitive, modern solution for tailoring enchantment mechanics to your server's exact economy and gameplay loop.

Built natively for modern Paper/Spigot versions (**1.21.1+**), this plugin intercepts enchantment tables and anvil mechanics down to the modern Mojang data component level, ensuring total security without sacrificing server performance.

## ✨ Features
**🚫 Granular Restrictions:** Ban specific enchantments dynamically based on the exact base item material (e.g., Block _Sharpness_ specifically on Axes, or _Protection_ on Leather).

**🔨 Complete Interaction Locking:** Completely prevents banned enchants from being generated on **Enchantment Tables** or combined via **Anvils** (including books).

**⚡ Instant Admin Control:** Hot-reload your configuration instantly in-game using ```/ceb reload```. No restarts required.

**👑 Built-in Bypass System:** Grant standard OPs or players with the ```enchantbanner.bypass``` permission complete freedom to ignore rules for admin items or event rewards.

**🎨 Fully Customizable Messages:** Tailor block warnings and admin feedback to match your server's unique theme with native color-code support.
